domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, manager decision, and optional cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT: Initial state when employee creates but has not yet submitted the request. Only the owning employee can view or modify. Transitions to SUBMITTED or CANCELLED.
SUBMITTED: Employee has submitted for manager review. The owning employee can only cancel; the designated manager can approve or reject. Transitions to APPROVED, REJECTED, or CANCELLED.
APPROVED: Manager has approved the leave. Immutable except for cancellation. Upon entry, the employee's LeaveBalance.usedDays and LeaveBalance.remainingDays are updated. Transitions to CANCELLED.
REJECTED: Manager has rejected the leave. Terminal state — no further transitions allowed.
CANCELLED: The request has been withdrawn. If cancelled from APPROVED, the balance is restored. Terminal state — no further transitions allowed.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Updated atomically when leave is approved or cancelled-from-approved.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Balance is in effect for the current fiscal year. Used for all leave calculations and validations. Transitions to EXHAUSTED when remainingDays reaches 0, or to CLOSED at fiscal year end.

EXHAUSTED: Employee has consumed all entitled days. No further leave of this type can be approved until the next fiscal year or unless an override is applied. Transitions to ACTIVE when the new fiscal year begins (reset).
CLOSED: Fiscal year has ended; balance is archived for audit. No further transactions allowed. Terminal state.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a category of leave. Each policy governs how many days are granted, whether accrual applies, minimum notice requirements, and whether manager approval is mandatory.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE: Policy is in effect and governs leave requests. Employees can apply under this policy; balances are derived from it. Transitions to INACTIVE.
INACTIVE: Policy is disabled. No new leave requests can reference this policy. Existing approved leaves and balances remain unaffected. Transitions to ACTIVE.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each value maps to a LeavePolicy that defines the rules for that category. The feature scope covers annual, sick, and emergency; unpaid, maternity, and paternity are defined for completeness.

business_rules: BR-001 — No overlapping leave: An employee cannot have two LeaveRequests with overlapping date ranges where both have status in {DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED}. Overlap is defined as: existing.startDate <= new.endDate AND existing.endDate >= new.startDate.

BR-002 — Sufficient balance check: Before transitioning a LeaveRequest from SUBMITTED to APPROVED, the system must verify that the employee's LeaveBalance.remainingDays for the corresponding policy is >= the number of calendar days in the requested date range (endDate - startDate + 1). If insufficient, the approval must be rejected with a balance-insufficient reason.

BR-003 — Balance deduction on approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the system atomically increments LeaveBalance.usedDays by the number of calendar days in the request and decrements LeaveBalance.remainingDays by the same amount. This must happen within the same transaction as the status change.

BR-004 — Balance restoration on cancellation from approved: When a LeaveRequest transitions from APPROVED to CANCELLED, the system atomically decrements LeaveBalance.usedDays and increments LeaveBalance.remainingDays by the number of calendar days originally deducted. This must happen within the same transaction.

BR-005 — Manager approval enforcement: If the LeavePolicy.requiresManagerApproval is true, only the employee's designated manager (Employee.managerId) may approve or reject the LeaveRequest. The system must validate that the acting user's employee ID matches the requestor's managerId before allowing the APPROVED or REJECTED transition.

BR-006 — Minimum notice period: When a LeaveRequest is submitted, if the associated LeavePolicy.minimumNoticeDays is set, the system must verify that startDate is at least minimumNoticeDays in the future from the submission date. If the check fails, the request must be rejected at submission time.
BR-007 — Active policy required: A LeaveRequest may only reference a LeavePolicy whose isActive is true. Attempting to create or submit a request against an inactive policy must be rejected.
